info.name: Pioneer DDJ-SB2 (Stems + Phrases)
info.author: Be, Michael Stahl (DG3NEC), erdnuz
info.description: Pioneer DDJ-SB2 with stem mute/solo pads (CUE LOOP mode), SHIFT+PLAY brake / soft start and phrase/section navigation (BANK mode). Needs tracks prepared with stemprep for stems and phrases.
